balances.description: Fund accounts and balances. Balances are computed server-side only.
balances.formulaNote: Balance = opening + confirmed receipts − confirmed payments + adjustments. Pending and rejected requests are excluded; adjustments append to the ledger and never rewrite history.
balances.empty: No fund accounts yet. Start with “New account”.

reports.description: Business figures by order creation date. Page and export share the same numbers.
reports.note: Booking, active and completed orders are included by default and broken down by status; cancelled orders are excluded unless ticked. “Pending” is a separate column from confirmed amounts.
reports.emptySuppliers: No supplier data in this range

applications.description: Payment requests go through two approval steps: finance review and admin final approval. Self-approval is forbidden; only the creator can withdraw; applicants are shown only as You/Other member.
